I've finished the Zig port. From a clean directory, `build.sh` builds a ReleaseFast binary at `./app`, and `node check.mjs` passes all 5 example cases.

I also checked it against the original Python program on six generated 1,000,000-command inputs with different capacities and key counts. Output was byte-for-byte identical every time, and each run took 0.02–0.05s. Seven hand-written edge inputs also matched Python exactly, covering CRLF line endings, tabs and repeated spaces, blank lines, unkno
